metadata.title: Micron earnings give a shot in the arm to the broader chip sector - MarketWatch

content.text:
15 hours ago
Micron earnings give a shot in the arm to the broader chip sector
Chip stocks are broadly seeing momentum following Micron's earnings report.
Shares of Marvell Technology and Intel are up more than 4%, while shares of Arm Holdings are up more than 6%. Nvidia's stock is ahead about 1%.
"Tech investors will be in a very positive mood and breathe a sigh of relief with the tech stalwart Micron flexing its muscles with its stellar earnings report," Wedbush analyst Daniel Ives said in a note to clients.
